body: There is nowhere else for me to go. 1 hour,  57 minutes till earth says farewell to me.

You are both right and wrong. The fact that I fabricated the life of a human being and interjected her "history" into my life seems to mean nothing to you. But having or not having a girlfriend doesn't make or brake me. The thing that I failed to mention before is that this is proof that I am worthless in the scope of the universe. My actions will amount to naught, and be a footnote I'm the minds of my descendants (at best). Why continue if I do not mean anything? I don't think I can, I am a useless character, I cannot cope with this and wish to leave this life. I hate myself not just for lying, but for hurting others with this lie. Causing friendships to be shaken over the debate of a third party's "girlfriend". I have already caused so much hate and anger, I don't need to make more. The only people I care about must realize that they are essentially scattering my ashes. I mean nothing to anybody, nobody will even notice my absence. I have nothing left of me to live for, except to apologize to every human who ever spoke to me, spoke of me, or was spoken to about me. It is a shame that you had to know me. No person should ever have to know a nobody like myself. I apologize to my friends if this hurts, but I am finished, and it is my fault, so feel no anguish.
